references.role: Horse direction, scale and painted finish

prompt:
Art for a 2D top-down fantasy role-playing game. Bright, colorful medieval fantasy in clear daylight. Realistic proportions, nothing cartoonish, nothing grim. No text, no borders, no watermarks, no drop shadows.

Create ONE wide landscape sprite source sheet with EXACTLY 12 isolated painted objects in a strict equally spaced FOUR columns × THREE rows. Each complete object centered in its own cell (four across, three down). Give every cell 14% empty margin on all four sides and no grid lines. All objects viewed from the same raised straight-on game camera, seeing top and front, about 35 degrees, front faces align screen left-right. No diagonal isometric rotations. These are detailed realistic hand-painted miniature props for the existing game, readable at 20–110 on-screen pixels. The first reference shows the game horse’s painted finish and direction. The second and third show the raised-camera game interior joinery and furniture texture. Use these as camera/style references only. The old flat stalls, tables and stools shown are placeholders and should not be copied. Do not draw any horses, riders, people, text or room backgrounds.

Row 1, left to right: (1) perfect BACK and SIDE PARTITION for one horse stall, a rustic timber U in plan with open foreground, exactly two outward ends pointing down-screen. Thick vertical aged oak posts with black iron corner bindings, pegged joints, low vertical rear/side kickboards and open gaps in upper side rails, tiny traces of straw. The central open bay must be genuinely transparent to place a horse there later. (2) SEPARATE matching LOW FRONT GATE for this stall, a wide horizontal gate facing camera, two stout keyed pillars with worn iron hinges and latch, exactly two narrow horizontal rails with large gaps, a sturdy low bottom rail. Leave over two thirds of the gap between posts visually transparent so a horse's body and legs behind it will remain readable. Nothing joins this gate to the previous object. Both pieces should look like joined stable architecture, not like a table. (3) worn wooden wall hay rack with visible slats and a small load of straw. (4) low weathered oak horse trough with dark water, riveted iron bands, open top.

Row 2, left to right: (1) distinct large oval oak poker table with turned legs, understated green worn felt, subtly painted chips and tiny cream playing cards with no visible letters or digits, timber rail and brassy joinery. (2) elegant visibly D-shaped blackjack table with flat rear dealer edge at top of image and broad curving player side in foreground, faded navy-blue baize with understated stitched scoring arcs, three tiny face-down cards, dark warm brown carved frame and stout legs. (3) compact roulette wheel and support stand, raised oak rim, brass hub, painted dark burgundy and black wedges, ivory ball, deep realistic painted perspective, sturdy carved legs and lower brace. (4) low backless oak stool with dark teal upholstered cushion, visible three tapered legs, worn seams and peg joinery, no oversized ornament.

Row 3, left to right: (1) narrow runner rug laid flat in the same raised-camera projection, long axis pointing vertically in the frame, time-worn muted blue cloth with small woven ochre diamonds, finely textured pile, not a graphic vector rectangle. (2) shallow tray with an open ledger and little ink pot with unlettered softly mottled parchment; on transparent alpha without table. (3) wooden board with bread, ceramic place setting and small tankard naturally arranged together; on alpha without table. (4) modest wooden tool tray with a hammer and tongs, subtle painted iron sheen and plausible construction.

A unified detailed painterly RPG finish, distinct wood grain and joinery wear, realistic lengths and thicknesses, warm oak, muted brass and believable iron. Use restrained upper-left daylight, internal material shadow, crisp high-contrast separated silhouettes. Genuine TRANSPARENT background in all gutters and open gaps. No ground, no shadow, no grass, nothing behind the character or object. No glow, haze or backdrop.
